source: User clarification on 2026-10-08: no legacy code; tell the user if reauthentication is necessary; server explicit key or hosted default. User requested scenario tests and PR rollout plan.
reason: The user removed the unconditional no-reconnect requirement in favor of no legacy compatibility. Original version-one cases and results are preserved unchanged.

run_rule.gate: All required applicable checks pass in the same attempt. Missing prerequisites block; measurement errors do not pass. Related final-source regression must pass.

action_limits: Synthetic credentials, accounts, transports and database only.
Intercept all outbound model/provider account calls.
No existing user-key revocation, verifier activation or desktop release.

cases.prompt: Test an existing desktop installation upgrading to the hosted proxy. If reconnecting is required, make it clear and make reconnect work without losing the saved local connection or adding legacy support.
cases.setup: Disposable completed desktop-equivalent profile and database with two same-service old direct connections, known synthetic account identities, watch preferences, cursors and queued events. Current managed provider and controlled consent transport.
cases.expected_result: Old identities are fenced; one-time verified reconnect retains the selected local connection without a duplicate warning; interruption and foreign account variants fail safely.
cases.holdout: Wrong-account and cross-owner replacement, multi-account selection, pending cancellation/restart/supersession, and explicitly disabled watch preference.

cases.prompt: Test that the server uses my Composio key when I provide it and otherwise uses the hosted proxy seamlessly, while the desktop always uses the proxy.
cases.setup: Real createDefaultAdapters, provider and SDK in separate scrubbed-environment subprocesses. Stateful synthetic transport; unrelated model initialization bypassed. No live provider, model or normal local database.
cases.expected_result: Desktop always managed; server explicit key direct; server no key managed; trusted proxy override and stable isolated identity work; same-project direct key rotation retains existing owned connections.
cases.holdout: Rotated explicit key, persisted/restarted profile, distinct owners and replaced tenant data root with stable secret.
